concept_en: The Value of a Half-Open File
question_cn: 什么是「半开放纵线」？它对车有什么价值？
question_en: What is a half-open file, and what value does it offer a rook?

options.text_cn: 只有己方兵被移走、对方兵还在的纵线；车在此施压对方兵，并随时准备在兑换后完全控制该线
options.text_en: A file with no friendly pawn but an enemy pawn remaining; a rook can pressure that pawn and take full control if it is exchanged.

options.text_cn: 双方都没有兵的纵线，与开放纵线完全相同
options.text_en: A file with no pawns from either side; it is identical to a fully open file.

options.text_cn: 有一个己方兵在上面的纵线，价值最大
options.text_en: A file occupied by one of your pawns; this is the most valuable kind.

options.text_cn: 半开放线没有实际价值，只有完全开放的纵线才重要
options.text_en: A half-open file has no real value; only fully open files matter.

explanation_cn: 半开放纵线指己方兵已离开、但对方兵仍在的纵线。车在半开放线上直接向对方兵施压，一旦对方被迫移动或兑换该兵，纵线立刻完全开放。这就是为什么西西里防御中黑方 ...c5 之后，c 线对黑方车来说是极有价值的半开放线——黑方可以预先把车放到 c8，等待兑换后立刻控制 c 线。
explanation_en: A half-open file has no friendly pawn but still contains an enemy pawn. A rook can pressure that pawn, and if it moves or is exchanged, the file may become fully open. In the Sicilian, Black's ...c5 often makes the c-file a valuable half-open file; Black can place a rook on c8 in preparation.
